summary: Cozy Wellness visual redesign verified end-to-end on frontend. Login page renders with sage bg, hand-drawn cat mascot, 'A little corner of calm' Fredoka heading, 'Welcome back' + rounded green 'Enter garden' pill button. Login (alex@demo.com/demo1234) succeeds and lands on home dashboard. Dashboard hero shows time-of-day greeting ('Good morning, Alex'), 'A calm start makes a strong day.' Fredoka heading, Kalam sub-copy, streak/pts/level pills, and the companion cat mascot. All renamed cards present: 🌸 WELLNESS GARDEN, 💡 DAILY WELLNESS FACT, 🌷 WELLNESS TIP · REFLECTION, ✨ COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHT · THIS WEEK, and 🌱 Today's rituals section — legacy labels (FEELING BRUTAL, DID YOU KNOW, WORD OF THE DAY, EMPLOYEE SPOTLIGHT, Wellness Score) fully removed. Navbar renders as rounded pills (Home/Journey/Mood/Community/Kudos + More) with theme-toggle and NotificationBell. Navigated to 13 routes (/leaderboard, /funwall, /mood, /profile, /shoutouts, /help, /music, /polls, /games, /quiz, /learn, /events, /teams) — every page uses cozy sage bg (#EEF5E8) with 0 hard black shadows and 0 thick (≥3px) black borders detected via DOM scan (global CSS overrides in index.css remap all legacy brutal-* utilities). Admin login + /admin renders cozily with all 10 tab labels visible (Users, Challenges, Reminders, Analytics, Feedback, Rewards, Quizzes, Points, Game Teams, Announcements). Theme toggle flips html.dark, body bg becomes #1E241B (rgb(30,36,27)) — dark palette applies globally. Mobile viewport (390px): bottom nav renders as floating pill with all 5 items (Home/Journey/Community/Mood/Me). Zero JS/console errors captured on any tested page.

issues: Peach hero card + peach text ('Good morning, Alex' and Kalam subtitle) is a bit low contrast in dark mode — legible but could be brightened. Minor polish.

design_issues.screen: Dashboard DAILY WELLNESS FACT card (dark mode)
issues: Bright cyan bg (#C8DFF0-ish) stays vivid in dark mode; a slightly muted dark-cyan would better match the cozy dark palette. Minor.
'CONTROL CENTER · DON'T BREAK STUFF' banner is a large dark rectangle — softer rounded corners applied but the copy still leans brutal. Consider softening tagline to match cozy tone.
Pixel-style yellow/pink/cyan boombox avatars still look 'brutal' compared to rest of UI (legacy identicon). Consider swapping to soft rounded initials or pastel avatars for consistency.

(Optional polish) Mute DAILY WELLNESS FACT cyan in dark mode

critical_code_review_comments: index.css uses `!important` heavily to override legacy brutal utilities — pragmatic for a quick pivot, but plan a follow-up pass to remove legacy class usages from JSX and drop the override block for maintainability.
Login form redirects to '/' (not '/dashboard') — works because '/' renders Dashboard, but PRD says 'redirect to dashboard'. Consider explicit navigate('/dashboard') for clarity, or update PRD text.
server.py still 1763 lines (carried over from prior iteration) — split recommendation stands.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all PRD acceptance criteria met across 15+ routes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cozy Wellness redesign is live and visually consistent across all routes thanks to global CSS overrides in /app/frontend/src/index.css remapping every legacy `bg-brutal-*`, `border-black`, `shadow-brutal*`, `border-[3-6px]`, `rounded-[2-4px]` utility to cozy tokens. Fonts (Fredoka/Nunito/Kalam) loaded via Google Fonts import. CompanionMascot SVG has 3 states (idle/happy/sad) with data-testid `mascot-<state>`. Theme toggle at [data-testid=theme-toggle] flips html.dark; both light and dark cozy palettes verified. Backend was not retested per request (frontend-only).
